title: text proposal: yesterday's price isnt todays price
summary:
Text proposal. Ratify https://s3.terp.network/static/gov/baseline-valuation/baseline.html as the working baseline for coordinating negotiations for the initial coordination of funds. YES adopts that document as the non-negotiable starting point for initial token pricing discussions, bootstrapping negotiations with external parties, and internal treasury valuation. It is a floor for those talks, not a market price, not a quote, and not an offer. NO rejects it. NO_WITH_VETO only if this proposal is spam or harmful to the chain. ABSTAIN takes no position. This proposal does not mint, burn, or move tokens, and it does not change consensus parameters. It has no inner messages.

The ratified object is the reference point and the block method, not a frozen spot price. Each verified block is one unit of work worth $1. The 6,641,532 missed blocks, held only in the historical archive, count $0.67 each, a one-third penalty. At height h, network value is V(h) = (h - 6,641,532) x $1 + 6,641,532 x $0.67. TERP baseline at h is V(h) divided by the total TERP supply at h. THIOL baseline at h is V(h) divided by the total THIOL supply at h. The baseline rises with every new block. The page shows a live height beside the reference; that live column is the same formula and is not a second price schedule.

Reference point, morocco-1, from height 1 (genesis 2022-04-10). Height 23,238,152 at 2026-09-15 15:06:14 UTC: 16,596,620 verified blocks and 6,641,532 missed blocks. App hash 4827CA4AE8FFA676C2D0E0C4A9DC7ABB90AE783C432EB0F87C4B6B709B06308D. BTC/USD $75,869.26 at 15:00 UTC on 15 Sep 2026, so $1 = 1,318 sats (Coinbase hourly candle and CoinGecko, as linked from the page).

Initial baseline at that reference. Verified work (23,238,152 - 6,641,532) x $1 = $16,596,620.00. Missed work 6,641,532 x $0.67 = $4,449,826.44. V = $21,046,446.44. TERP supply 419,894,441.995 gives $21,046,446.44 / 419,894,441.995 = $0.05012, about 66 sats. THIOL supply 891,626,585.813 gives $21,046,446.44 / 891,626,585.813 = $0.02360, about 31 sats. Supply is the total on-chain supply of each token as of 29 Sep 2026, because public nodes no longer serve state from the reference height. Dollar figures are rounded to five decimal places for the token prices.

Terp Network's value in this baseline comes from integrity and verifiability: the work the network performs, the cost of keeping full historical state, and continuity as infrastructure. Missed blocks still count, at a penalty, because full history supports state reconstruction, audit, and interoperability. Passage makes this the working baseline for coordinating those fund negotiations. It does not set a trading price and it does not instruct a transfer.
